title: Vegetative faculties as an attribute-and-order reconstruction target
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: Vat.lat.3468 f38r is reported to personify four vegetative faculties with distinctive attributes. After native source collation, a fixed conjunction of attributes, owned role labels and their actual order could discriminate a shared functional diagram from a four-figure resemblance.
source_facts: Bonner and Soler (2016), Imago 8, pp.131–142, p.135 fig.5 (DOI 10.7203/imago.8.9153), identify Vat.lat.3468 f38r as four women: Appetitiva with fruit/cup, Retentiva with a hand at the chest, Digestiva with a small mill, and Expulsiva defecating. They place the manuscript in the fifteenth century; Villalba, Faventia 17/2 (1995), p.71, identifies 1428. These are scholarly descriptions reported by root, not this producer's native image readings. No pictorial order, caption ownership or Voynich correspondence has been collated.

design.mechanism: A shared personification schema would preserve a conjunction of distinct role attributes and their source-attested ordering, allowing role identity and figure correspondence to be inferred jointly.
design.source: Vatican Library Vat.lat.3468 f38r; Bonner/Soler fig.5 is a reproduction pointer, pending native manuscript collation.
design.required_source_collation: Obtain a legible provenance-bound image; independently record all four complete figures, visible objects/actions, literal readable captions and singular caption ownership. Freeze the actual layout order, explicit links and any licensed orientation before target selection. Do not replace pictorial order with the physiological or article-list order.
design.prediction: A subsequently and independently nominated admitted target must admit one complete assignment preserving every securely collated role-specific attribute together with the source's fixed order/relations and its target inscription ownership. Attributes and order may each remain ambiguous separately; their intersection must identify the assignment.
design.falsifier: A secure contradiction in any required attributed action/object, owned label relation or source-frozen order excludes that assignment; no complete assignment rejects this specific homolog. Missing or illegible details remain missing data. Multiple compatible assignments remain unidentifiable.
design.countermodel: Figures depict patients, generic personifications or another faculty system; matching the number four or isolated cups, gestures or machinery does not require the entire fixed conjunction.
design.smallest_test: Source-only collation first. Proceed to a target test only after one concrete admitted target is nominated under a separate frozen rule and demonstrates evaluable attributes plus inscription ownership. No target has been nominated in this proposal.
design.access_status: Root reports UB PDF requests yielding maintenance HTML, journal access returning 403, guessed Vatican endpoints returning 404, and screenshots yielding no usable image. These access failures neither verify the manuscript details nor refute the hypothesis.
design.selection_status: Unreviewed source proposal, not executable target comparison, decoding or permission to inspect a new page.
design.prior_duplicate_pointers: GDT208 and GDT209 primary reports concern broad personified medical/alchemical apparatus and lack this fixed source. Route-check returned no matching fixed faculty route; the GDT625 vegetative lexical hit does not establish duplicate identity. Novelty remains for root review.
design.decision_by_outcome: A complete native source conjunction would permit one source-specific target nomination; incomplete collation parks the source. Any later unique target correspondence would be a local role-binding lead requiring held confirmation, not an established Voynich translation.
design.budget: A selected source-access pass gets 15 minutes total including collation, compact validation and publication. Stop on continued unavailability; no serial endpoint guessing, decoder work or target search by recollection.
